confirmed_harness_cause: tests/browser/member-chat-visible-proof.mjs stores the immediate sample as report.member_answer_proof, treats later next_frame and scroll_bottom samples only as diagnostics, and finally asserts immediate. The later same-article eligible state cannot affect the verdict. next_frame is only a phase label in prepareMemberAnswerScreenshot; no requestAnimationFrame is awaited. The screenshot operation between samples consumed about 0.6 seconds while the transcript ancestor opacity changed from 0 to 1.
distinct_from_d249: Closed EXT-D-0249 was guest screenshot clone pruning of painted semantic text under zero-rectangle structural wrappers. This case uses the member DOM Range/paint checker; it correctly rejects opacity 0 initially, then correctly accepts opacity 1. The false negative is which temporal sample the member orchestrator treats as authoritative. No evidence warrants reopening D249 or weakening its semantic/hidden exclusions.
minimal_repair_proposal: Use a bounded member paint-readiness loop around the existing real selected assistant article, active Chat pane and expected visible term. After a candidate becomes eligible, capture its screenshot and re-evaluate the same selected article/term immediately after capture. Only a paired, stable eligible observation with a successful screenshot can become report.member_answer_proof and return success. Keep the original immediate sample in diagnostics. A later scroll-bottom diagnostic cannot substitute for the paired proof. Preserve the prior two-terminal-turn, authenticated organization, intended demo target and exact artifact checks.
required_negative_guards: Opacity/display/visibility-hidden or occluded answer remains refused even if term text exists.
Wrong assistant article, stale earlier reply, wrong expected term, inactive Chat or offscreen term remains refused.
Article identity or eligible geometry changes between pre-screenshot and post-screenshot check refuses the pair.
Screenshot capture failure, target loss and exhausted bounded readiness remain unverified with sanitized diagnostics.
No success can derive solely from next_frame or scroll_bottom diagnostic state.
open_question: The product/style source that temporarily set transcript ancestor opacity to 0 is not isolated by this report; animation_count was 0 at both sampled times. A paired source repair can address the harness false negative without asserting a CSS root cause or native acceptance pass.
